candidates.hook: A wooden door bangs open to reveal Alexander panting in the doorway, clutching his blood-soaked chest.
candidates.cliffhanger: Juliana applies salve to his wound while Alexander ignores the pain and stares intently into her eyes.
candidates.why: Starts with an immediate life-or-death visual hook and transitions into intense romantic tension between the leads.

candidates.hook: Alexander strips off his shirt, revealing a torso covered in fresh bleeding lacerations and battle scars as Juliana gasps 'Dear God.'
candidates.cliffhanger: Alexander pulls Juliana's hands to his bare chest, confessing 'Your touch is the only medicine that has ever eased my pain,' cutting on her stunned reaction.
candidates.why: Delivers a visual body reveal hook followed by a high-stakes emotional confession that leaves the viewer dying to see if they kiss.

candidates.hook: Juliana challenges her stubborn injured husband: 'Then removing your shirt should not trouble you.'
candidates.cliffhanger: Alexander reaches up and suddenly pulls Juliana's hands onto his bare chest over his racing heart.
candidates.why: Establishes a strong female lead challenging a stubborn warrior, escalating quickly into intense physical proximity.

moments.desc: Door bangs open; Alexander appears bloodied and panting at the threshold.
Alexander pulls off his shirt, revealing severe wounds and scars to Juliana's horror.
Alexander places Juliana's hands over his bare heart and confesses she is his only medicine.
